Eloise (Design): dropped a new concept for the embeddings export and batch-input flow: https://www.figma.com/file/new-concept. Key diffs: 1) column-mapping step in export modal 2) paste CSV batch-input with inline validation 3) provenance header option in CSV. looking for quick feedback. Ravi (PM): nice. product asks: column-mapping is great for downstream teams. default map should match visible columns but let users reorder or rename columns before download. provenance opt-in is good but keep it off by default. Jun (Eng): implementation notes: mapping UI can emit a mapping object client-side used to generate CSV headers. for large exports (>10k) we should server-side stream and apply mapping there. paste CSV validation: run a lightweight header & row-count check client-side and show errors inline. Marta (A11y): a11y flags: mapping grid must be keyboard navigable (arrow cells) and announce cell edits. paste flow needs clear error announcements. export modal should be role=dialog with focus on first input and trap focus. also provide a downloadable sample CSV template. Hannah (Product): microcopy suggestions: change primary CTA to "Download vectors & metadata (CSV)" and helper copy: "Only visible columns included by default. Use column mapping to rename or reorder headers. For large exports we will prepare a background file." add small info link: "What is provenance?" design-bot: contrast check: primary CTA #0756D6 on #FFFFFF passes AA large, fails AA small. consider #064BB3 Eloise (Design): will update copy and add a small "provenance (opt-in)" checkbox with tooltip explaining model/config/timestamp included. adding sample template download and inline validation states for paste. Jun (Eng): keyboard/ARIA specifics: mapping grid as `role=grid` with `aria-readonly=false`. announce changes via `aria-live=\"polite\"` region when mapping saved. paste errors should populate `role=status` live region. for background exports return job-id and provide accessible link in notification. Marta (A11y): example live region snippet for paste errors: ```
Row 3: missing vector values
``` For grid: use `aria-colindex` and `aria-rowindex` and ensure cell focusable. Ravi (PM): analytics: track when users use column mapping, download provenance, and paste-upload vs file-upload. also record when background export triggered. Eloise (Design): will push updated Figma with: mapping grid keyboard states, sample CSV template, paste validation flows, copy tweaks, and 10k+ background export mocks. aiming for Wed morning. Marta (A11y): follow-up checklist: 1) role=dialog & focus trap 2) grid keyboard nav & ARIA indices 3) live regions for paste/errors & mapping saves 4) announce background job submission and link 5) accessible sample template link. I'll re-run SR pass after update. Jun (Eng): noted. I'll prepare backend mapping hook and streaming export endpoints and client-side validation. Hannah (Product): thanks team. small UX ask: show an estimated export size and if provenance is on show an estimated extra size. Eloise (Design): will include the size estimate mock and the provenance tooltip. closing when Figma updated. :thumbsup:
